cc:Work.dc:description: Raw TensorBoard train/confidence_loss data without smoothing. Each series is sorted by optimizer step; duplicate baseline steps use the latest wall-time record. Left: all supplied points. Right: steps 13020–26040, with an expanded loss scale.
